desc: Count frequency of each number in A, then for each g from 1 to max_A, compute count[g] = number of elements in A divisible by g (using sieve-like iteration).

For each number v from 1 to max_A, precompute best[v] = largest divisor d of v such that count[d] >= K. This can be done by iterating over all g with count[g] >= K, and for each multiple m of g, update best[m] = max(best[m], g).
Handle edge cases and ensure efficient I/O for large inputs.
